asked.item: Filter List Comments by isAuthor false
Tell audience comments from own replies

verdict.reason: The query parameter table lists the supported filters, which don't include isAuthor, and the comment object says isAuthor marks audience comments.

steps.text: The List Comments query parameters are limit, cursor, platform, accountId, parentCommentId, postId, since and until.
isAuthor is not one of the listed query parameters.
Each comment in the response has an isAuthor field, which is false for an audience reply and true when your connected account wrote the comment.
